context: Repair Autobahn local verification and merge-authority boundaries without treating workflow discovery as execution or local CI as hosted CI.
root_causes: The pre-merge driver previously invoked command inventory without executing derived local CI.
Verification needs complete command/cwd prevalidation and a bounded argv grammar to prevent unsafe interpretation or partial execution.
The bypass adapter previously accepted apply mode and token presence without requiring explicit approved marker and matching readback.
evidence: Current run-gates.sh diff replaces --derive inventory with local-ci.sh execution.
Current ci-gate.sh and regression-test diffs introduce structured commands, contained cwd validation, and all-before-any prevalidation.
Current merge-authority.sh diff restricts approved bypass to host-supported-bypass marker, matching readback, and nonempty token.

Recorded red/green evidence and independent approval are in .ai/evidence/autobahn-fail-closed-gates.json. Focused suites passed 259 checks; measured coverage is unavailable and hosted CI remains pending.
solutions: Execute only the bounded literal GitHub CI subset through the shared verifier; refuse unsupported workflows.
Prevalidate every verification entry and run allowlisted argv in physically contained cwd.
Require explicit approved bypass evidence and document ordinary authorized merge separately.
acceptance_criteria: Local CI executes the supported literal workflow command list instead of treating inventory as execution.
Unsupported workflow syntax or execution context, absent runnable CI, and failed commands block the local gate; hosted checks remain independently required at the exact commit SHA.
Every verification command, executable, script, and contained cwd is validated before any command runs; execution uses argv without a shell.
Legacy verification strings retain root cwd; exact cwd/command objects permit only normalized physically contained directories.
Merge-policy bypass requires an explicit approved marker, matching readback, and confirmation token; missing, malformed, conflicting or rejected verdicts fail closed.
An explicitly authorized ordinary merge uses normal host policy after exact-head CI and review gates; it never fabricates bypass evidence.
Regression tests, final local validation, independent review, and hosted CI are recorded before delivery; no readiness or approval is inferred from this document.
legacy_risk_reason: Execution and merge authorization are security boundaries; preserve fail-closed behavior with adversarial regression fixtures.
coverage_basis: Conservative zero policy input selects legacy-safe TDD; not a measured coverage result.
delivery_blockers: Exact-head hosted CI after the test portability fix remains pending.
